'''Sean Morrison''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Atlanta DPC]] on 28 July 2001, according to Devon Clark's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2752">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-atlanta-dpc-7-28-01d2752/ atlanta-dpc-7-28-01], DeckTech (Devon "Devonator" Clark, 31 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-31-atlanta-dpc-7-28-01d2752/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
